objective: Test whether the Analysis 1 vector-refitting advantage is retained when BiomedCLIP is replaced by an architecturally matched general-domain CLIP image encoder.

cohorts.CBIS-DDSM: 655 complete breast cases from the locked Paper B development cohort
cohorts.Derm7pt: 609 cases from the locked Paper B development cohort

fixed_elements: The existing cohort membership, labels, patient groups, outer folds, inner exclusions, and image preprocessing are retained.
Only the frozen image encoder is changed.
Concept probes use balanced logistic regression with C=1.
Analysis 1 includes S, C, C_flex, and M.
Diagnostic-head selection uses C in [0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100] and the existing four-fold inner procedure.
Affine calibration uses the existing positive-slope L-BFGS-B implementation.
C_flex uses the existing restricted-cubic-spline representation, knots, capacity, and selection procedure.

paired_contrasts: C_flex to M class-equal NLL gain
S to M class-equal NLL gain
outcomes.confidence_intervals: 95% paired cluster bootstrap intervals with 10000 resamples

interpretation_rule: Differences between BiomedCLIP and CLIP will be reported as encoder-dependent findings. They will not be attributed solely to the pretraining domain because the encoders differ in learned parameters and training data despite sharing the ViT-B/16 architecture.
